title: DSES Event Envelope
description: Decision-Sequence Evidence Schema v0.1.0. Normative envelope for a single event in a human-AI decision sequence. License: MIT. Author: Joshua M. Henderson, Ph.D., Evidify LLC.

event_id.description: Globally unique identifier for this event.

event_type.description: One of the ten core DSES event types, or a namespaced extension type (containing a dot).

oneOf.description: Extension event type in a reverse-namespace form, e.g. 'org_example.custom_event'.

sequence.description: Monotonic per-case ordinal assigned by the recording system. Ordering claims rest on this plus integrity class, never on timestamps alone.

ordering.description: Set to 'indeterminate' when the recording system cannot establish this event's true order. An honest gap outranks a fabricated sequence.

occurred_at.description: Wall-clock time of the underlying occurrence, as known to the source system.

recorded_at.description: Wall-clock time the recording system durably wrote the event. Divergence from occurred_at is evidence and must not be silently normalized.

case_ref.description: Pseudonymous case reference. Must not contain direct identifiers.

workflow_ref.description: Identifier of the workflow definition in force.

actor.description: Required for human-attributed events (human_state_committed, human_state_revised, final_decision_committed, attestation_recorded, ai_result_presented, ai_result_interacted).

ai_system.description: Required for ai_result_available, ai_result_presented, ai_result_interacted. Version identity is mandatory.

deployment_id.description: Identifier of the specific deployment or configuration.

exposure.description: Required for ai_result_presented; recommended for context_signal_recorded. Enumerates ALL exposure classes conveyed, not the most severe.

payload_ref.description: Reference to the exposed content, held in the local store.

payload_commitment.description: Cryptographic commitment (hash) to the exposed content, for integrity class I2 and above.

decision_state_ref.description: Required for human_state_committed, human_state_revised, final_decision_committed. Reference to, or at I2+ a cryptographic commitment to, the decision-state content.

prior_decision_state_ref.description: Required for human_state_revised. The committed state being superseded.

information_state.description: Required for human_state_committed, human_state_revised, final_decision_committed. The actor's accumulated exposure classes at the moment of commitment, and the derived independence class.

independence_class.description: Derived per Section 6.2: UNEXPOSED iff exposure_classes is empty; INDIRECTLY_EXPOSED iff only PRIORITY and/or PRESENCE; DIRECTLY_EXPOSED if any of CATEGORICAL, LOCALIZATION, QUANTITATIVE, NARRATIVE, DIRECTIVE; POST_ACTION if AGENTIC present.

text_ref.description: Reference to free-text rationale, held in the local store.

class.description: Integrity class of the recording pathway. A case sequence's overall class is the minimum across its events.

event_hash.description: Required at I2+. Hash of the canonicalized event content.

prev_event_hash.description: Required at I2+. Hash of the preceding event in the case chain; genesis events use a documented genesis value.

canonicalization.description: Canonical serialization scheme used before hashing, e.g. 'RFC8785'.

enforcement.description: At I3 with enforced ordering: the enforcement pattern(s) in force.

anchor.description: At I3 with external anchoring: the anchoring mechanism and proof reference.

extensions.description: Namespaced extension payloads. Keys must contain a dot (reverse-namespace convention).
